en: A sepia-toned photograph of a substantial early-20th‑century urban villa or institutional building in a European city. The structure has multiple wings with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and classical detailing around tall arched windows. A veranda or conservatory projects from one side. In the foreground are a wooden picket fence, a tree-lined sidewalk, a streetlamp, tram or trolley wires, and a single pedestrian in light clothing walking along the street. The image has a white border typical of vintage postcards.
